title: Optimize evals sync prep - Priya (Jul 08 2026)
body:
Short goal:
Prepare for Thu 2026-07-09 15m sync with the small Optimize/Evals crew. End state: pick one immediate mitigation (rollback OR tactical prompt patch OR score-threshold rule) and assign owners + deadlines.

Background (1-paragraph):
We rolled prompt-v3-ab into retail-chat at 40% starting Jul 1. Metrics window Jul 1-7 shows a drop in precision@1 from 0.882 -> 0.841 (control -> AB), delta -0.041 absolute, p<0.01. Failures are concentrated on multi-turn follow-ups where model hallucinates product attributes or incorrectly mentions prices (often invents cents). Raising score threshold mitigates false positives but harms recall. There are three plausible causes: prompt wording change, recent post-process scorer change, or production traffic shift.

Key numbers I'll share (single-line bullets):
- n_control=18.1k, n_ab=12.4k
- p@1_control=0.882, p@1_ab=0.841, delta=-0.041 (rel -4.6%)
- failure subset: price-question + spec-compare = 75% of failures
- eval set: retail-chat-aug-v2 (210 targeted edge cases seeded)

Representative examples (high-level, will paste 2 control / 2 AB in GH):
- Example A: user asks "does this come in black?" Follow-up: AB answer invents SKU attribute "matte black" not in catalog.
- Example B: user asks "what's the price after tax?" AB returns $19.99 when product list shows $19.00.
- Example C (control): correct ask-back for clarification.
- Example D (AB): confidently asserts unavailable warranty length.

Hypotheses (to surface quickly):
- H1: Prompt templating change in v3-ab encourages speculative completions (diff attached in PR 1423).
- H2: Post-process scorer change (PR 1402) mishandles long context / KV cache boundary -> wrong normalized confidences.
- H3: Traffic drift (week of Jul 1 had heavier price-question share) exposed blind spots not covered by retail-chat-aug-v2 despite seeding.

Quick repro checks (commands I can run during sync or immediately after):
- Run small AB sampler: python tools/ab_slice_check.py --flow retail-chat --since 2026-07-01 --until 2026-07-07 --slice price-question
- Replay 500 failed traces through control vs ab: tools/replay_batch.sh retail-chat failed-traces-500
- Diff prompts: git --no-pager diff origin/main..prompt-v3-ab -- prompts/retail-chat/*.tpl | sed -n '1,200p'
- Scorer sanity: curl internal-api/scorer/health && python tools/scorer_check.py --max-context 2048

Immediate mitigation options (fast -> slightly slower):
- Option A: Rollback AB to control for retail-chat (Pros: fastest, safest; Cons: loses any potential gains; Ops time ~15min; Owner: Leo).
- Option B: Hot prompt micropatch: revert the templating fragment that expands attribute completions (small text change). Pros: targetted, preserves traffic split; Cons: risk of missing underlying scorer bug; Owner: Amara; estimate 1-2hrs including smoke tests.
- Option C: Score-threshold override for price-question intents (increase from 0.60 -> 0.72). Pros: quick, no code deploy; Cons: hurts recall on real price extraction; Owner: Diego; estimate 30min to configure + 1 day monitor.

Decision criteria I want us to agree on in the 15m sync (short):
- If p@1 delta > 0.03 AND failure severity includes incorrect price mentions -> prefer rollback or micropatch within 2 business days.
- If repro shows scorer health issues -> prioritize rollback until scorer PR is validated.
- If drift is primary cause -> adjust eval set + throttle AB until new eval coverage is added.

Proposed immediate ask to team during meeting (concrete):
- Give me a thumbs-up for one of A/B/C within the meeting (target = end of 15m).
- If rollback chosen: Leo to execute within 1 hour and post rollback note to #optimize-alerts.
- If micropatch chosen: Amara to create hotfix PR and request one reviewer; Diego to run smoke replay. Deploy gated on 200-sample smoke pass.
- If score-threshold chosen: Diego to apply rule and publish metric snapshot at +1h and +24h.

Follow-ups (owners + due):
- Short-term (24-72h):
  - Root-cause deep-dive (run diagnostics across the scorer change vs prompt diff) — Priya + Leo — due: 2026-07-12
  - Expand eval coverage for price-question variants by +600 examples — Amara — due: 2026-07-16
  - Instrument a canary that flags price-mention hallucinations (alert if rate > 0.5% of traffic) — Diego/SRE — due: 2026-07-14

Medium-term (2-4 weeks):
- Add automated intent-specific threshold tuning in Optimize (RFC and prototype) — Priya/eng — due: 2026-08-01
- Add regression tests to CI that include production-sampled failure traces each deploy — Eng test infra — due: 2026-07-30

Parking lot (not for immediate call):
- Consider adding a small ask-back prompt when price mentions are detected (UX tradeoffs).
- Evaluate a lightweight secondary verifier model for numeric attributes.

Notes to self (prep talking points):
- Keep TL;DR to one line at start.
- Bring 3 real examples that show the failure pattern (avoid long lists).
- Ask the team to prefer the lowest blast-radius fix unless we find a clear scoring bug.

Meeting checklist (5 minutes before):
- Confirm GH snippet with examples is public to meeting attendees.
- Ensure dashboards (p@1 by intent, traffic split, failure examples) are live and linked in the meeting thread.
- Post quick agenda in #optimize.

Possible questions I might get and short answers:
- Q: "How sure are we it's AB and not traffic?" -> A: show per-hour traffic composition for price-question slice; if AB change concentrated during same hours -> stronger signal.
- Q: "Can we hotfix only for price-question flows?" -> A: Yes via routing rule or threshold override; risks are partial coverage.

Next steps after meeting (my checklist):
- Update JIRA with chosen mitigation and owners.
- Run replay and push summary to Confluence.
- Circle back with CS if any known customer incidents relate to these failures.

End.
